tapeLine: US stocks were mixed Thursday: the S&P 500 fell 0.47% to 7,765.36 and the Nasdaq Composite 1.25% to 27,193.34 while the Dow added 51.77 points to 51,231.64, as an FT report questioning OpenAI's revenue hit AI-linked chip stocks, per CNBC and Motley Fool. Sources disagreed on the 10-year yield's direction and close (CNBC intraday readings of 5.227% and 5.322%; Motley Fool 5.28%), so no yield level is carried. No Friday-morning futures were found.
matters:
The Nasdaq fell 1.25% Thursday after a Financial Times report cast doubt on OpenAI's revenue, hitting Nvidia, Micron and Intel, per CNBC. The Dow edged higher.

The 10-year yield reached its highest level since 2002 on Wednesday, per CNBC; Thursday's close could not be confirmed. The September FOMC minutes came out Wednesday; secondary sources describe a 12-0 hike to 3.75%–4.00%, not confirmed against the Fed's text. The next FOMC meeting is 27–28 October.

Invalidation: whether chip and AI stocks keep selling off, and whether the 10-year holds near its multi-year high.
alsoOnTape: Oil and gold are not carried: no dated, consistent levels were found this session.

secondOrder: Chip stocks fell on a single press report while yields sat near 24-year highs. That is an observation, not a forecast.

scorecard.text: Wednesday's test was whether indexes hold near Tuesday's record closes. Thursday the S&P 500 fell a further 0.47% to 7,765.36 and the Nasdaq 1.25%, per CNBC.
Wednesday's test of the 10-year holding above 5.3% is unresolved: Thursday readings ranged from 5.227% to 5.322% and sources disagreed.
The 27-28 October FOMC has not occurred.
